request.description:
receiver_type: customer or supplier
receiver_id: id of that customer/supplier
sms_template_id: optional, must belong to the current branch
title, message: support placeholders {name}, {due_amount}, {date}, {company_name} — auto-substituted per receiver

recipient_type: all | customer | supplier | contact_group
contact_group_id: required only when recipient_type is contact_group
sms_template_id: optional
title, message: same placeholder support, resolved per recipient
